title: Pay the waste levy on waste received
what: Pay the EPA the prescribed contribution (the waste levy) on all waste received at a licensed waste facility.

laws.title: Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997 (NSW)

sources.title: Protection of the Environment Operations Act 1997 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: The occupier of a waste facility to which this section applies is required to pay to the EPA in respect of all waste received at the facility such contribution as is prescribed by the regulations
